newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall on poor overseas buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall on poor overseas buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Wednesday fell to 1,189/1,190 rupees per quintal from 1,208/1,210 rupees on renewed speculative selling, dealers said.
"Absence of fresh overseas buying as well as higher new crop arrivals prompted bull operators to liquidate long positions while bears turned active," one dealer said.
Sentiments was subdued following weak trend in the world market. In Rotterdam castoroil prices fell by 15 to 775 dollars per tonne.
Groundnut oil moved down by 2 rupees to 342/343 rupees per 10 kg amid demand resistance while higher prices attracted profit-taking.
In Rajkot spot oil fell by 2/3 rupees to 517/518 rupees per 15 kg.
"Imported palm oil was steady at 281/282 rupees per 10 kg on limited physical buying but sentiment was subdued on arrivals of about 5,000 tonnes at Bombay port," one miller said.
